player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in SimpleTak.
On the board, your stones appear as '{player_stone}' and your opponent's stones appear as '{opponent_stone}'.

On your turn, choose one empty cell (by its numbered index) and place your stone there.
For example, '[12]' places your stone in cell 12.

Your objective is to form a continuous path of your stones that connects two opposite edges of the board (top-to-bottom or left-to-right).

invalid_move.invalid_move_format: Sega ni dodonu na kena ibulibuli
invalid_move.cell_out_of_range: Celula e sega ni dodonu {cell_num}. Sa na tu ga kina na 0 kei {max_board_num}.
invalid_move.cell_already_occupied: Sa tiko e dua na vale ni {cell_num}. Digitaka e dua tale na vanua lala.

action.placement: Player {current_player_id} sa vakaraitaki e nona itavi ({symbol}) ena celula {cell_num}.

outcome.winner: Player {current_player_id} ('{symbol}') sa vakayacori na veitabaki e rua na ivakarau!
outcome.draw: Sa sinai na iwiliwili ni lewe, sa sega tale ga ni dua e vo!
